name: Exploring the Horde

angles.text: You meet the leaders guiding the Horde across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.
Nazgrel advises Warchief Thrall in Orgrimmar and guides young orc warriors making their mark.
Speaking with Shadow Hunter Vol'jin strengthens the bond between the Darkspear tribe and their orc allies in the Valley of Spirits.
Meeting High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff brings you to the spiritual heart and strength of the tauren.
Traveling to the Undercity to meet the Dark Lady Sylvanas Windrunner shows the Forsaken's strategic, if tense, alliance with Kalimdor's Horde.

aliases: what do you do in this quest
faq.answer: You report to Nazgrel in Grommash Hold, then travel across Horde lands to meet Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
faq.q: What is the quest Exploring the Horde?

faq.answer: Nazgrel is an orc warrior and trusted lieutenant in Grommash Hold, within Orgrimmar. He advises the Horde and directs aspiring champions to commanders and allies across its lands.
faq.q: Who is Nazgrel and where is he located?

aliases: which leaders do i talk to
faq.answer: You meet Shadow Hunter Vol'jin of the Darkspear trolls, High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof of the tauren in Mulgore, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the Banshee Queen of the Forsaken in the Undercity.
faq.q: Which leaders are you sent to meet?

faq.answer: The Horde's peoples are bound by shared survival and pacts of brotherhood. Meeting Vol'jin, Cairne and Sylvanas shows you the alliance's reach, from Durotar and Mulgore to Lordaeron.
faq.q: Why are adventurers instructed to visit each leader?

aliases: how to find voljin cairne sylvanas
faq.answer: Vol'jin is among the Darkspear trolls in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits. Cairne Bloodhoof holds court atop the mesas of Thunder Bluff in Mulgore. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner resides in the Undercity's Royal Quarter beneath the ruins of Lordaeron.
faq.q: Where can each of the leaders be found?

faq.answer: Grommash Hold is the central fortress in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. Named for Grom Hellscream, it is where Warchief Thrall and his advisors, including Nazgrel, oversee Horde affairs.

sections.body: Nazgrel sends you from Grommash Hold into the wider Horde lands. The fortress stands at the heart of Orgrimmar, where Nazgrel and the Warchief's council oversee military affairs. You leave Durotar's red canyons behind to learn how far the peoples beneath the red banner are joined.
sections.title: Orders from Grommash Hold

sections.body: You meet the leaders of the Horde's allied peoples: Shadow Hunter Vol'jin of the Darkspear trolls, High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof of the tauren, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, queen of the Forsaken. Speaking with each in person lets you see the ties between Kalimdor and Lordaeron, across the Great Sea, where plague has scarred the land.
sections.title: An Alliance of Survival

summary: From Grommash Hold, you travel to meet the leaders who guide the Horde. The journey carries you from Orgrimmar to the Darkspear trolls, the tauren and the Forsaken.
attribution: In-game quest text: Exploring the Horde
